game.name: JASF : Jane's Advanced Strike Fighters (USA)
game.desc: Jane's Advanced Strike Fighters for Xbox 360 takes us into a fictional civil war in the heart of Azbaristan. The player can take control of 30 different aircraft to complete 16 missions in a territory of 65,000 square kilometres. Multiplayer modes accommodate up to 16 participants in versus and four participants in co-op.
